🇦🇷 Diego Maradona was born on October 30, 1960, in Argentina. Growing up in a poor neighborhood, Maradona discovered his extraordinary football talent at an early age. He became a professional as a teenager and developed into one of the most creative and influential players the game had ever seen. His greatest international achievement came at the 1986 FIFA World Cup, where he played a leading role in Argentina's triumph.
